title: Transfer learning guided discovery of efficient perovskite oxide for alkaline water oxidation.
summary: Learned composition screening guided synthesis of new perovskite oxides, with electrochemical confirmation of water-oxidation performance. Measured catalyst behavior, not deployment readiness.
ai_technology: Transfer learning with pretrained, ensemble and active-learning models
organization: Xiamen University; University of Liverpool; Shenzhen University

evidence.tested: Learned composition screening guided synthesis of new perovskite oxides, with electrochemical confirmation of water-oxidation performance. Measured catalyst behavior, not deployment readiness.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
